name: FounderOmni
tagline: Connected marketing and operations for founders — invitation-based Beta
description: FounderOmni is a connected marketing and operations platform for founders and lean teams. It brings nine applications into one workspace: Omni SEO & GEO, Web Analytics, Social, Email, Forms, Schedule, Sign, Links and Affiliates. Search and website evidence can be turned into prioritized SEO and GEO recommendations and briefs for AI assistants. The wider platform supports social publishing workflows, email campaigns, response collection, meeting bookings, everyday e-signatures, measurable campaign links and partner programs. Agent access through MCP is available on eligible Core and higher plans, with permissions and workspace controls. The main workspace remains an invitation-based Founding Beta. Public product information, pricing, resources and free browser tools can be explored separately. FounderOmni offers Free, Core and Advanced product plans; availability and limits are described on its official website.
